name: Eien ga Kizamu Kioku no Kakera
original_name: 永遠が刻む記憶のカケラ
source:
Kazuma meets several persons in a row: a classmate, a senior student, a girl who claims to be his fiancee.
These encounters bring what kind of change to his school life?
